name: QNB Finansal Kiralama A.S.
summary: QNB Finansal Kiralama A.S. provides financial leasing services in Turkey and internationally. It offers finance leasing services for business and construction machinery, metalworking machines, real estate, energy and energy efficiency equipment, medical devices and equipment, yacht/boat, agricultural machinery, audio and video systems, elevators and escalators, power transmission and distribution systems, passenger cars, aircraft, special purpose vehicles, printing machines, textile machinery, commercial vehicles, heating and cooling equipment, furniture equipment, production machinery, and technological equipment.
